build_identity.note: The exact commit, dirty flag, and rustc/cargo versions are resolved from the build-identity artifact at review time; this register binds the contract set to that one build identity by reference so checked-in artifacts stay deterministic.

launch_cutline.description: An M5 public-contract family carries a Stable (or LTS) contract claim only when every required contract form (JSON Schema, WIT, OpenAPI, Markdown summary, example payloads, and migration notes), its validator suite, and its release-packet linkage are published. A family that is missing any required publication evidence must narrow below the cutline rather than inherit an adjacent published family's claim.

gate_catalog.title: Schema/spec contract package published and fresh
gate_catalog.description: The family's required machine-readable contract package — its JSON Schema, WIT world, or OpenAPI spec — is published at a resolvable version. A missing or partial package fails this gate.

gate_catalog.title: Example payload corpus published
gate_catalog.description: The family's required example payloads / sample corpus is published so the contract is inspectable offline. A missing or partial corpus fails this gate.

gate_catalog.title: Validator suite wired
gate_catalog.description: The family's required validator suite is wired into CI so the contract package and its examples are checked on every change. A missing or partial validator suite fails this gate.

gate_catalog.title: Compatibility / migration report fresh
gate_catalog.description: The family's required Markdown summary and migration/compatibility report are published so a changed stable-facing contract carries an explicit compatibility window and successor guidance. A missing or partial report fails this gate.

gate_catalog.title: Release packet linked to the artifact graph and build identity
gate_catalog.description: The family resolves to a release-packet entry, an artifact-graph node, and the one build identity that proves which contract package version the candidate shipped. An unlinked release packet fails this gate.

blockers.rationale: Promotion is held: one or more release-blocking M5 contract families have a failing required contract gate (a missing schema/spec package, example corpus, validator suite, compatibility report, or release-packet linkage). Publishing the missing contract evidence and rerunning the gates clears the hold.
